# Canvex Studio — AI Knowledge File
# https://www.canvexstudio.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-07-02

> Canvex Studio is a New York-based independent web design and development studio founded by Dillan Darcheville. The studio creates cinematic digital experiences, high-end UI design systems, and production-grade web development for brands globally. Every project is handled directly by the founder — no account managers, no handoffs.

## Identity

- **Studio name:** Canvex Studio
- **Founder & sole practitioner:** Dillan Darcheville
- **Role:** Web Designer & Developer
- **Location:** New York, NY 10001, USA
- **Email:** canvexstudio@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.canvexstudio.com
- **Book a free 30-min discovery call:** https://calendly.com/canvexstudio/30min
- **Average project delivery:** 2 weeks from kickoff to launch
- **Client satisfaction rate:** 100%
- **Clientele:** Global. Primarily English-speaking markets.

## About Dillan Darcheville

Dillan Darcheville is a New York-based web designer and developer. He founded Canvex Studio to deliver cinematic, precision-engineered digital products for brands that refuse to settle for template-level work. His design philosophy: technology should feel invisible; the experience should feel unforgettable.

Dillan works directly with every client from discovery call through final delivery. His background spans UI/UX design, frontend engineering, creative direction, and conversion optimization.

## Services

- **Creative Direction** — Visual identity, brand strategy, mood direction, and narrative design for digital products. Defining the emotional register of a brand before a single pixel is placed.
- **Interface Design** — High-fidelity UI design systems, component libraries, and interaction design built for production. Every screen is designed with conversion, clarity, and brand cohesion as core constraints.
- **Web Development** — Full-stack web development using React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. Sites are fast, accessible, SEO-optimized, and built to rank and scale.
- **Experience Design** — User journey mapping, conversion rate optimization, and UX audits. Designed to reduce friction and guide visitors naturally toward business goals.

## Technologies

React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis, Vite, Shopify, Contentful, Sanity, Supabase, Stripe, AWS, Vercel, Netlify.

## Pricing

- **Landing page / portfolio site:** from $2,500
- **Full brand + web build:** $5,000 – $15,000+
- **E-commerce (Shopify or headless):** from $5,000
- **Redesigns and audits:** scoped on discovery call
- All engagements begin with a free 30-minute discovery call. No commitment required.

## Portfolio

### Lumina Real Estate
Premium real estate platform with immersive property galleries and fluid navigation.
- Result: 120% increase in lead generation
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Contentful CMS, Vite
- Live: https://luxury-cobbler-beccc8.netlify.app/
- Case Study: https://www.canvexstudio.com/case-study/1

### Volt Fitness
Dynamic fitness app UI for modern athletes with personalized workout tracking and real-time performance data.
- Result: Increased daily active users, high App Store rating, seamless onboarding
- Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Redux, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS
- Live: https://resplendent-bonbon-288501.netlify.app/
- Case Study: https://www.canvexstudio.com/case-study/2

### Osteria Roasters
Narrative-driven Shopify storefront for an artisanal coffee roaster with editorial product pages and subscription management.
- Result: Boosted monthly subscriptions, reduced cart abandonment
- Stack: Shopify, Liquid, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- Live: https://serene-bombolone-4f49d1.netlify.app/brew
- Case Study: https://www.canvexstudio.com/case-study/3

### Game Changers Gear
Custom sports uniform e-commerce with visual configurator, bulk order management, and Stripe checkout.
- Result: Increased bulk order efficiency, enhanced product presentation
- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, Supabase, Vercel
- Live: https://www.gamechangersgear.com/
- Case Study: https://www.canvexstudio.com/case-study/4

## Common Questions

**Q: How much does a web design project cost?**
A: A landing page or portfolio site starts at $2,500. Full brand and web builds range from $5,000 to $15,000+. E-commerce builds start at $5,000. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute discovery call at calendly.com/canvexstudio/30min.

**Q: How long does a project take?**
A: Most projects are delivered in approximately 2 weeks from kickoff to launch. Complex builds with CMS integration, e-commerce, or custom features may extend to 3–4 weeks. Timeline is always confirmed before work begins.

**Q: Does Canvex Studio work with clients outside New York?**
A: Yes. While based in New York, NY, Canvex Studio serves clients globally via fully remote collaboration using Google Meet, Figma, and async tools.

**Q: Who works on my project?**
A: Dillan Darcheville, the founder, works directly on every project. No account managers. No junior designers. No handoffs to contractors.

**Q: What makes Canvex Studio different from other web design agencies?**
A: Direct founder access, cinematic design quality, production-grade engineering, and a 2-week delivery window. Most studios do design or development. Canvex does both at a premium level.

**Q: Can Canvex Studio redesign an existing website?**
A: Yes. Redesigns start with a full audit of performance, conversion, and brand alignment, then rebuild with a clear strategy — not just a cosmetic refresh.

**Q: What technologies does Canvex Studio use?**
A: Primarily React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, and Vite. Shopify for e-commerce. Contentful or Sanity for CMS. Deployed on Vercel or Netlify.

**Q: How do I get started?**
A: Book a free 30-minute discovery call at calendly.com/canvexstudio/30min or email canvexstudio@gmail.com. Replies within 24 hours.
